demo_B.gated_floor_note: the gated tail converges to a small flat floor (~0.08) rather than 0: a Friedkin-Johnsen-type equilibrium from the per-camp anchors (stubborn priors), amplified ~3x by the gate. Controls (probe, seed 0): bare gate omega=1 -> 0.000; anchors alone -> ~0.03; gate+anchors -> ~0.09. Parameter-level disagreement, vs the rival wall's categorical certainty 35x higher.

mechanism: K candidate wirings per agent + prequential model posterior (the structure-discriminating evidence the deposit erases now accumulates in L) + hypothesis-aligned fusion (no cross-frame averaging) + damped log-linear hypothesis pooling (wall height ~ source / (2 alpha_m), predicted before measured)
